item.title: Bi-weekly update, 17 November 2026
item.dc:creator: Maverick
item.content:encoded:
Protocol update, over the last two weeks:

+ rETH supply declined -1.5% to 303,185.

+ Pending/active validator count increased 5.5% to 16,583.

+ Node operator count increased 2.8% to 1,417.

Smart Node:

+ v1.25.2 of the Smart Node is a high-priority upgrade for Lighthouse & Reth users, and medium priority for Besu, Nethermind, Teku, & Commit-Boost users: (https://github.com/rocket-pool/smartnode/releases/tag/v1.25.2).

R&D:

+ The Saturn Two upgrade remains on track for a May launch. Devnet 1 is nearly ready but requires the (delayed) launch of Ethereum’s Glamsterdam fork before going live. Devnet 2 is expected in January, and Devnet 3 in February.

Governance:

+ Onchain votes are live for RPIP-86 and RPIP-88: (https://rocketdash.net/vote).

+ The latest pDAO treasury reporting is available: (https://dao.rocketpool.net/t/pdao-2026–09–24–2026–10–22-treasury-report/4138).

+ The GMC opened Round 43 of Grants, Bounties, & Retro funding: (https://dao.rocketpool.net/tag/gmc-round-43/71).

+ The latest GMC reporting is available: (https://dao.rocketpool.net/t/gmc-2026–10–01–2026–10–31-treasury-report/4166).

Ecosystem:

+ The IMC’s new mainnet liquidity strategy is live: (https://x.com/GammaStrategies/status/2123068091739648046).

+ Rocket Pool attended the Ethereum Institutional Forum in London: (https://x.com/Rocket_Pool/status/2120909091090653251).

+ The Defiant covered MEGAPOOL validator launches: (https://x.com/DefiantNews/status/2122459950710665495).

About Rocket Pool:

Rocket Pool is Ethereum’s most decentralised liquid staking protocol. Its 1,500 worldwide node operators have staked over 500,000 ETH. Liquid stakers can participate by depositing as little as 0.01 ETH to receive the rETH liquid staking token. Rocket Pool is a fully non-custodial solution, and its node operators are economically aligned to perform well for stakers. Joining as a node operator is fully permissionless and requires just 4 ETH (instead of 32). A boosted ROI is provided from both operator commission plus optional RPL rewards. The Rocket Pool team have been in the staking space since its inception in 2016, which gives them a pedigree and track record without peer. Comments and views expressed in this content do not constitute any kind of advice, financial or otherwise.

Bi-weekly update, 17 November 2026 was originally published in Rocket Pool on Medium, where people are continuing the conversation by highlighting and responding to this story.
